model: A transport-neutral ordered event stream shared by WebSocket and SSE implementations. The stream carries canonical data references, heartbeats, reorg notices and replacement notices with deterministic sequence and resume semantics.
invariants: stream sequence numbers are generated monotonically and never reused
resume cursors are bound to the V13.5 cursor schema
resume begins strictly after the delivered sequence encoded in the cursor
future or malformed cursors fail closed
heartbeat events carry freshness and canonical-head metadata without inventing record identity
reorg notices reference the affected record explicitly
replacement notices reference distinct affected and replacement record IDs
resume responses are bounded to 100 events
WebSocket and SSE transports must expose identical stream ordering and cursor semantics
stream state grants no execution, custody, mint, burn or settlement authority
